title: Bounded Family Sample Count
statement: Let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ be a rational learning parameter, and let $M$ be a positive integer. Define the bounded-family sample count as the Fourier estimator sample count at accuracy $\varepsilon/(2M)$ and confidence $1/(20M)$.
caveat: The Fourier estimator sample-count definition is not included, so its exact formula cannot be rendered.
